Data & sources
Corridor designations: FHWA National Highway Freight Network (U.S. DOT); dataset: BTS Geospatial — NHFN. The Interstate System shown constitutes the backbone of the NHFN’s Primary Highway Freight System west of the Mississippi.
Highway geometry: Natural Earth 1:10m Roads (public domain), clipped at the Mississippi River.
